belief_limitation_note: N1 CONFIGURATION, NOT A PLAYING CONFIGURATION. This bot loads and warms joe's frozen 8,556,250-parameter transformer at startup and then decides through the network-free ShapedUniformEvaluator: the observation bridge (N2) and the 4410->3970 remap plus the 128-bin value decode (N3) are not written yet, so nothing consults the net. It is a running, finishing, deliberately weak seat, and its rating means nothing. Every knob below is INHERITED FROM morpheus-rs AND STILL DESCRIBES THE 249,316-PARAMETER CNN, whose per-component costs are wrong for this binary by orders of magnitude. N4 rewrites the file from N0's measured costs per joe-net-plan.md section 5.3, and K0 attaches four non-optional conditions to that rewrite: pending_leaf_batch 4 -> 1 (at 4 the controller admitted ZERO simulations on every turn of 8,166), widen_freeze_below 16 -> 2, target_simulations 16 -> 8, and a new prior_temperature knob. None of the four is applied here, because changing search knobs while the search evaluates a flat prior would tune against a bot nobody is going to ship. Removed at N1 rather than left lying: use_policy_proposal (the branch it selected is deleted - section 3.3), max_proposal_batch (it capped policy batches only, and was provably inert once that branch went), network_width and trunk_channels (they described the CNN's shape and mean nothing for a transformer). offline_p99_ms.belief_tensor and offline_p99_ms.enemy_prior_batch are still here on purpose: COST_COMPONENTS is a wire format shared with the runtime parity surface and the trace schema, so retiring a component is an N3/N4 change with its own gate, not a config edit. Qualification verdict: no on any host, and not a candidate for one until N4.
